entries.question: Job ke liye kaise apply kre
entries.answer:
KGMU mein jobs (faculty, non-teaching, ya resident positions) ke liye apply karne ki jankari aapko KGMU ki official website par mil jayegi.

Aap niche diye gaye steps follow kar sakte hain:

1. **Website visit karein:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jayein.
2. **Careers/Recruitment Section:** Website par 'Careers' ya 'Recruitment' ka tab dhundein, wahan par current job openings aur unke liye application forms ya process ki jankari uplabdh hoti hai.
3. **Notifications:** KGMU samay-samay par newspapers aur apni website par vigyapan (advertisements) nikalta hai. Aap [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) ko regularly check karte rahein.

**Zaroori Baat:**
*   KGMU mein kisi bhi job ke liye apply karne se pehle official notification ko dhyan se padhein, kyunki har post (Faculty, Nursing, Admin, ya Residency) ke liye process alag ho sakti hai.
*   Kisi bhi anjaan vyakti ya website ko job dilwane ke naam par paise na dein. KGMU ki bharti prakriya hamesha transparent aur official notification ke madhyam se hoti hai.

Agar aap kisi specific post (jaise Residency ya Faculty) ke bare mein puchna chahte hain, toh kripya batayein taaki main aapko sahi link provide kar saku.

entries.question: क्या केजीएमयू में पेडियाट्रिक सर्जरी होती है
entries.answer:
हाँ, किंग जॉर्ज मेडिकल यूनिवर्सिटी (KGMU) में पीडियाट्रिक सर्जरी (बच्चों की सर्जरी) की सुविधा उपलब्ध है।

आप पीडियाट्रिक सर्जरी विभाग के बारे में अधिक जानकारी यहाँ देख सकते हैं:
[https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=7&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=7&dept_type=2)

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* **OPD अपॉइंटमेंट:** केजीएमयू में ओपीडी के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) पर जाकर या 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333 पर कॉल करके अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
* **पर्ची का शुल्क:** ओपीडी पंजीकरण का शुल्क ₹50 है।
* **समय:** ओपीडी का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक है (रविवार को ओपीडी बंद रहती है)।

कृपया किसी भी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी या लक्षणों को यहाँ साझा न करें। यदि आपको कोई चिकित्सीय समस्या है, तो कृपया केजीएमयू ओपीडी (KGMU OPD) में डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

entries.question: Ops appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, please follow one of the methods below. Please note that online registration is mandatory.

**1. Online Portal (Recommended)**
*   Visit: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital.
*   Click 'New Appointment', select the department, date, and time slot.
*   Enter your patient details and pay the ₹50 fee online to download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the online portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in Registration**
*   If you visit the hospital, you must carry your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number.
*   Visit the registration counter, provide your details, receive an OTP, and pay the ₹50 fee to get your physical OPD slip.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open Mon–Fri (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Sat (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.
*   **Referrals:** Patients coming from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for their specific department.

*I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.*

*   **Surgical Oncology:** Located on the **Second Floor, Room No. 203**. It operates on **Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday**.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Registration:** Online registration is mandatory for all OPD visits. You can book your appointment via [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in), the mobile app, or by calling 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333.
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid medical referral for the department.
*   **Safety:** I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (such as Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.

If you are a new patient, please arrive early as the registration counters close at 1:00 PM.

entries.question: Diploma in physiotherapy mai admission kaise le
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Diploma in Physiotherapy mein admission ke liye aapko university ki official website www.kgmu.org par jaakar 'Courses & Admissions' section check karna hoga.

1. **Website Visit karein:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaayein.
2. **Admissions Section:** 'Courses & Admission' tab par click karein aur Diploma courses ki list check karein.

entries.question: Mujhe vericose vein ka ilaj karwana hai
entries.answer:
I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

For treatment of varicose veins, you should visit the **Department of General Surgery** or **Department of Vascular Surgery** at KGMU.

To consult a doctor, you must book an appointment:
*   **Online:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   **Phone:** Call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
*   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT [Your Name]" to 8887019134
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the KGMU OPD registration counter with your Aadhaar card. Please note that registration is mandatory and the OPD fee is ₹50.

OPD timings are Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). It is strongly recommended to pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.

entries.question: Pcbe me kitna % chahiye
entries.answer:
MBBS aur BDS jaise medical courses mein admission ke liye, NEET (UG) ke niyam ke anusar 12th (10+2) mein Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology aur English hona anivarya hai.

Eligibility ke liye minimum percentage (PCB mein) category ke anusar is prakar hai:

*   **General (UR) / EWS category:** 50% marks
*   **OBC / SC / ST category:** 40% marks
*   **PwD (Persons with Disability):** 45% marks

**Dhyan dein:**
1. Yeh percentages Physics, Chemistry aur Biology (PCB) ke marks ka yog (aggregate) hote hain.
2. Iske alawa, NEET (UG) ki entrance exam ko qualify karna zaruri hai.
3. KGMU mein admission ki prakriya NEET counseling ke madhyam se hoti hai.

Agar aap kisi specific course (jaise Nursing ya Paramedical) ke bare mein puch rahe hain, toh kripya uska naam batayein, kyunki har course ke liye eligibility criteria alag ho sakte hain. Adhik jaankari ke liye aap [www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par dekh sakte hain.
